Every receipt tied exactly on merchant, date, card (**** 4417) and amount. Two policy calls worth noting:
- **MacBook was capitalized**, not expensed: £2,349 × 1.25 (March rate) = $2,936, over the $2,500 threshold. Depreciation starts April (£65.25/mo over 36 months) — asset tag UK-0231 needs adding to the register.
- Atlassian (monthly) and Google Ads (March-only) don't qualify as prepaids, so both hit March expense.

**Could not clear — 1 item (£3,840.00), flagged as EXC-001**

JE-00274, the 17 March faster payment to "KLM Consult" ref 88213. There is no invoice, contract, email or bill anywhere in the document store — the only hit is the bank statement line itself. It's also not settling anything already on the books: no KLM bill in AP, nothing in accruals, no prior consulting activity. Since I can't tell whether it's an expense, a prepaid, a deposit, or something that shouldn't have gone out at all, I left it in Suspense rather than guessing. It needs the KLM invoice/engagement letter and payment authorization from the UK team — and given it's a manual bank transfer with zero paper trail, I'd suggest confirming it's legitimate before it's expensed.

Suspense now sits at exactly £3,840.00, which is the KLM item alone. I didn't mark any checklist item complete since there's no dedicated suspense line and the full bank rec hasn't been done. The memo with full detail has been submitted to the controller.
